'''Ovakar''' was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] of the [[Sith Empire (Post–Great Hyperspace War)|resurgent Sith Empire]] living during the [[Galactic War]]. In [[3642 BBY]] Ovakar resided inside [[Darth Vengean's Compound]] when Lord [[Draahg]] and [[Empire's Wrath|another apprentice]] of [[Darth Baras]] stormed the compound, intending to kill [[Darth Vengean]] on their master's orders. Ovakar engaged the intruders, but was defeated.
